paper: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: portrait full-screen background texture for a charming hand-drawn graphite hangman mobile game. Subtle soft irregular creases from lightly crumpled then flattened paper, gentle paper fibers, very faint cool gray thin horizontal notebook rules at consistent spacing across the whole sheet. Small faint punched binder holes along the extreme LEFT edge, within leftmost 3% of width. Reference feel: real gently crumpled lined paper, but much lighter and quieter, no harsh folds or dark shadows, middle and upper left must remain clean for dark pencil game art and readable UI. No writing, no letters, no sketches, no pencils, no objects, no UI, no notebook binding, no surrounding desk or border, no curled edges. Entire canvas is paper. Soft even diffuse lighting. Production-quality game background, 1024x1536 portrait.
gallows: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: isolated transparent game sprite for a friendly hand-drawn graphite hangman game on notebook paper. Draw ONE EMPTY GALLOWS FRAME in a tall portrait 2:3 canvas. Rough natural dark graphite pencil sketch, slight line wobble, variable stroke thickness and sparse pencil hatching, matching a graphite stickman. Flat 2D front view. Exact layout: vertical timber post at 18% of canvas width, rising from 90% of canvas height from top up to 10%; horizontal upper beam at 10% height extends from x18% to x82%; a small diagonal brace from post x18% y25% to beam x40% y10%. A single very thin slightly irregular vertical rope at x82%, hanging from beam y10% down to y20%, ending in a plain straight tip. NO NOOSE, NO LOOP, NO KNOT AT TIP. Narrow loosely scribbled ground/base horizontal stroke from x5% to x95% at y90%. Timber outlined and lightly graphite shaded; not solid black, avoid chunky cartoon shapes. Plenty of empty fully transparent interior for a stickman BELOW the rope, absolutely no person or character. No text, no letters, no writing, no labels, no background, no paper texture. Entire background is genuinely transparent alpha. Sprite must have clean usable silhouette, all timber/base/rope inside frame with margins. The rope must be thin compared to timber.
